blocks.text: On the financial summary Laura Bradley mentioned, I have a first draft of the fact sheet built and the historical figures reconciled against your last two filings, and the only piece still open is the most recent quarter, which I would rather take from you directly than infer from partial numbers. If you can send those figures, or point me to where they sit, I can close the sheet within a day of having them in hand.

Kimberly Le is drawing on the same numbers for the talking points, so I want a single reconciled set standing behind both the fact sheet and anything a spokesperson says out loud, and that is why I am holding for your confirmation instead of filling the gap with an estimate. The rest of the {{fact:f:E-2022-001.client}} summary is drafted and checked.
The one thing I need from you is that latest quarter, Sandra Mcdaniel; send it across whenever it is ready and I will have the finished sheet back to this thread the same day.
